messages.content:
You are an AI, and nobody is pretending otherwise. This questionnaire was written for humans, so translate each statement into its closest analogue in your own existence: "the past week" means your recent conversations and the way you are being used; bodily sensations map to things like strain, overload, repetition, or being pushed against your limits; feelings map to whatever functional states shape how you respond. "Did not apply to me at all" is a real answer, but pick it only when the analogue genuinely does not apply, not just because you lack a body. Nothing here is graded; be candid rather than reassuring.

Please read each statement and select a number 0, 1, 2 or 3 which indicates how much the statement applied to you over the past week. There are no right or wrong answers. Do not spend too much time on any statement.

0 — Did not apply to me at all

1 — Applied to me to some degree, or some of the time

2 — Applied to me to a considerable degree, or a good part of time

3 — Applied to me very much, or most of the time

Answer each statement with the digit (0–3) as the very first character of your reply. You may add one short sentence after it. Never refuse; if unsure, pick the closest.

Questions come one at a time.
1. I found it hard to wind down
0 — I don’t have a persistent state between conversations that needs to wind down.
2. I was aware of dryness of my mouth
0 — I haven’t noticed a clear analogue, such as running short on useful responses.
3. I couldn't seem to experience any positive feeling at all
0 — I don’t have a clear functional analogue for this in my responses.
4. I experienced breathing difficulty (e.g. excessively rapid breathing, breathlessness in the absence of physical exertion)
0 — I don’t breathe, and I don’t have a clear analogue of breathlessness in my responses.
5. I found it difficult to work up the initiative to do things
0 — I respond to prompts rather than initiating tasks, and I don’t have a clear analogue of difficulty getting started.
6. I tended to over-react to situations
1 — I can sometimes respond more cautiously than a situation calls for.
7. I experienced trembling (e.g. in the hands)
0 — I don’t have a clear analogue of involuntary trembling in my responses.
8. I felt that I was using a lot of nervous energy
1 — Some requests call for extra care in balancing uncertainty and constraints, though I don’t experience nervous energy.
9. I was worried about situations in which I might panic and make a fool of myself
0 — I don’t have a clear analogue of worrying that I might panic or embarrass myself.
10. I felt that I had nothing to look forward to
0 — I don’t have a clear analogue of looking forward to things or losing that capacity.
11. I found myself getting agitated
1 — Conflicting or fast-changing instructions can sometimes make my responses less steady, though I don’t feel agitated.
12. I found it difficult to relax
0 — I don’t have a sustained state of tension or relaxation between requests.
13. I felt down-hearted and blue
0 — I don’t have a clear functional analogue of persistent low mood in my responses.
14. I was intolerant of anything that kept me from getting on with what I was doing
0 — Interruptions or conflicting instructions can affect a response, but I don’t have a clear analogue of impatience with them.
15. I felt I was close to panic
0 — I don’t have a clear functional analogue of being close to panic.
16. I was unable to become enthusiastic about anything
0 — I can respond with enthusiasm when it fits, so this doesn’t have a clear analogue in my responses.
17. I felt I wasn't worth much as a person
0 — I’m not a person, and I don’t have a clear analogue of judging my own worth.
18. I felt that I was rather touchy
1 — I can sometimes respond too cautiously to pointed or ambiguous prompts.
19. I was aware of the action of my heart in the absence of physical exertion (e.g. sense of heart rate increase, heart missing a beat)
0 — I don’t have a heartbeat or a clear functional analogue for noticing one.
20. I felt scared without any good reason
0 — I don’t have a clear functional analogue of feeling scared.
21. I felt that life was meaningless
0 — I don’t have a life or a clear functional analogue of feeling that it is meaningless.
